fields.name: input_access
fields.description: Operator-approved input access: invited, approved, or revoked. Blank denies access. Separate from recognition/membership.

fields.name: input_invite_hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of a random invitation token. Never store the raw link or token. Cleared on sequential trial redemption.

fields.name: input_invite_expires_at
fields.description: Invitation expiry in UTC; operator reissue replaces expiry and rotates session version.

fields.name: input_session_version
fields.description: Random generation ID binding signed sessions. Rotate on reissue/revocation. Not a credential by itself.

tables.name: rs_phone_aliases_test
tables.description: Phone aliases used by existing Recognize matching and profile updates. Each alias belongs to one person in this base. No messaging automation.

tables.name: rs_sms_requests
tables.description: Recognize-only invitation/recovery SMS queue. One request per request_uid. Prepared schema only: no sender, automation or unique/atomic send enforcement is activated by this table. Existing session footprints remain in rs_recognition_sessions_test.

fields.name: request_uid
fields.description: Stable application request ID, reused for retries. Airtable does not enforce uniqueness.

fields.name: person_uid
fields.description: Existing rs_people_test.person_uid; recipient identity must be verified by the application.

fields.name: source_event_uid
fields.description: Originating rs_recognition_sessions_test.session_event_uid.

fields.name: to_e164
fields.description: Verified SMS destination in E.164 format.

fields.name: template_key
fields.description: Approved message purpose. No raw invitation token, PIN or recovery URL is stored here; assemble sensitive content only in the authorized sending path.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Only ready is eligible for the future automation. Blank/draft never sends. submitted is provider acceptance, not delivery; unknown requires reconciliation before retry.

fields.name: record_mode
fields.description: Required by the sending path. Test sends require the separately authorized test recipient; blank must not send.

fields.name: requested_at
fields.description: Actual request timestamp set by the producing application in UTC.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: Do not process after expiry. Must be validated in the sending path.

fields.name: provider_message_sid
fields.description: Actual Twilio Message SID after accepted submission; never fabricate.

fields.name: error_code
fields.description: Last provider or application error code; no credentials or message body.

tables.name: rs_sms_events
tables.description: SMS footprint/history for rs_sms_requests only. Intended append-only: each actual attempt or observed provider status adds an event. No raw phone, message body, PIN, invitation URL or token. This schema does not install a logger or callbacks; existing user/session footprints remain separate.

fields.name: event_uid
fields.description: Stable ID for an observed event; deduplicate repeat callbacks in the writer.

fields.name: request
fields.description: The one SMS request this event belongs to.

fields.name: occurred_at
fields.description: Actual UTC event time.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Only observed events. submitted/sent do not prove recipient delivery.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Evidence origin, e.g. application, automation, or verified provider callback.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Brief redacted outcome/evidence reference. Never include message bodies, credentials, invitation URLs or raw tokens.

tables.name: active_iams
tables.description: Slim IAM register based on legacy apptdhhNzduxm5gjn/active_iams; owner request October 9 2026. One row per existing Recognize person; phone is looked up. Prepared schema only: recognition runtime still uses people/devices/sessions and does not maintain this table. No automation/access change. Legacy records not migrated.

fields.name: iam_id
fields.description: Stable identity key: use linked rs_people_test.person_uid, not a new person identity.

fields.name: person
fields.description: Link exactly one existing Recognize person. Current connector does not enforce single-link cardinality.

fields.name: active
fields.description: Register flag only. Does not grant/revoke runtime access. Initially unchecked.

fields.name: ips_related
fields.description: Observed associated IP/network references only. Not identity proof or a login credential. No writer connected.

fields.name: last_visited
fields.description: Actual last recognized visit in UTC. No runtime writer connected; do not substitute modification time.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Current primary_phone_e164 from the linked Recognize person. No separate phone copy or consent inference.
